name: Dhak Blend | Aluminium Coffee Capsules

variants: Pack of 10: ₹428 | Pack of 16: ₹466 | Pack of 36: ₹932
description: This medium roast is our signature house blend and is used to brew espresso-based coffees across our cafes. The silver oak blend is an extremely versatile choice that has a balanced flavour profile and works really well as an espresso.

name: Attikan Estate | Aluminium Coffee Capsules [Pack of 10]
description: Sweet with fruity overtones and balanced acidity, attikan estate is the darkest of our standard medium roasts and is perfect to brew an espresso with. It boasts of a bold and fruity profile, rounded off with a hint of nuttiness.

name: Vienna Roast | Aluminium Coffee Capsules
variants: Pack of 10: ₹428 | Pack of 16: ₹466 | Pack of 36: ₹932
description: The second darkest of our roasts, this blend has a great body, low acidity and is a favourite choice for coffee drinkers who enjoy a strong cup, with the characteristic bittersweet notes

name: Cold Brew Kalledeverapura Bags
description: Enjoy hassle-free cold brew with our easy-to-use bags - great for beginners and seasoned brewers alike! this single estate cold brew is a medium roast sourced from one of our oldest farm partners, kalledevarapura estate, situated in the hills of chikmagalur. With beautiful notes of stone fruit and toffee, this blend can be enjoyed black or with milk.

name: Cold Brew Bold Blend Bags
description: Enjoy hassle-free cold brew with our easy-to-use bags - great for beginners and seasoned brewers alike! our cold brew bold is a dark roast perfect for those who enjoy a robust kick in their coffee and prefer low acidity. This blend has a nutty flavour profile with notes of dark chocolate and roasted nuts. Perfect for milky drinks.

name: Cold Brew Light Blend Bags
description: Enjoy hassle-free cold brew with our easy-to-use bags - great for beginners and seasoned brewers alike! if you enjoy a fruity flavour profile, this one’s for you. Our cold brew light is a refreshing blend that shines with fruity notes of berry and subtle hints of white chocolate, best consumed black.

name: Chilli Cinnamon Mocha (Pack Of 5)
description: (20 ml x 5) this drop balances deep cocoa notes with a hit of chilli and a lush, date-like sweetness. With minimal bitterness, it is perfect for days that call for a little bit of spunk. We love it with ice and milk. But, feel free to make it your own with any twist you like.

name: Jaggery Coffee (Pack Of 5)
description: (20 ml x 5) this drop reminds us of a rich cup of south indian filter coffee, and is just what we imagine comfort in a cup to be like. With notes of toffee, dark chocolate, and vanilla, it tastes great black, and also pairs well with milk. Feel free to make it your own with any twist you like.

name: Sea Salt Mocha (Pack Of 5)
description: (20 ml x 5) this drop is how we slip a little indulgence into our days. Its sweetness is perfectly balanced by the sea salt, letting notes of salted caramel, milk chocolate, and candy shine. We are always tempted to pour it over ice cream for a quick affogato.

name: Americano Coffee (Pack Of 10)
description: (20 ml x 10) this drop brews a solid, satisfying cup of black coffee with notes of cocoa, dried fruits, and toffee. With medium bitterness, it is both a dependable daily driver and a great base for coffee experiments. We love it as is but feel free to make it your own with any twist you like.

name: Mixed Bag Coffee (Pack Of 10)
description: (20 ml x 10) enjoy some of our favourite recipes in a simple mix-and-drink form. This mixed bag contains: -  americano x2 signature x2 sea salt mocha x 2 chilli cinnamon mocha x2 jaggery x2

name: Monsoon Malabar

name: Attikan Estate, Medium Dark Roast
variants: Pack of 10 Sachets: ₹476 | Pack of 5 Sachets: ₹285
description: If you like your coffee a little dark, but not too much, this one is perfect for you. It has low acidity and flavor notes of figs, dark chocolate, and roasted almonds. The delicious nuttiness of this medium dark roast hits all the right notes, whether enjoyed with milk or black. Each box contains 10 easy pour sachets

name: Seethargundu Estate, Light Roast
variants: Pack of 10 Sachets: ₹476 | Pack of 5 Sachets: ₹285
description: Light + fruity seethargundu estate is an old blue tokai favourite and a treat for light roast fans. With taste notes of black tea, raisin and hazelnut, it s perfect for when you need that instant pick me up each box contains 10 easy pour sachets

variants: Pack of 10 Sachets: ₹476 | Pack of 5 Sachets: ₹285

The nachammai estate is a light roast that makes a fruity and zesty cup while vienna is a dark roast that is bitter and bold. In the middle range, thogarihunkal estate is a fruity medium roast and the attikan estate is medium dark that packs a nutty, chocolatey punch each box contains 10 easy pour sachets

name: French Roast, Very Dark Roast
variants: Pack of 10 Sachets: ₹476 | Pack of 5 Sachets: ₹285
description: Cocoa + bittersweet savour the bittersweet and cocoa notes of our darkest roast. If you like your coffee bittersweet and with minimal acidity, our french roast is perfect for you

name: Jacaranda Blend, Medium Dark Roast
variants: Pack of 10 Sachets: ₹476 | Pack of 5 Sachets: ₹285

name: Vienna, Dark Roast
variants: Pack of 10 sachets: ₹476 | Pack of 5 Sachets: ₹285
description: Bold + strong oaky, with overtones of cocoa and a hint of bitterness, this smooth dark roast is a classic. Every cup is heavy bodied with low acidity and is perfect for those who love the sharp, bold taste of coffee each box contains 10 easy pour sachets

name: Baarbara Estate [250 gms]
description: This coffee has medium-high acidity and medium-high bitterness. Our medium dark coffee from baarbara estate has a wonderful aroma of sweet caramel and dried apricot. To taste the syrupy, smooth mouthfeel of this coffee, we recommend brewing it as a pour over, an espresso or using an aeropress, moka pot or a french press.

name: Vienna Roast [250 gms]
description: This coffee has low acidity and high bitterness. The second darkest of our roasts, this blend has great body, low acidity and is a favourite choice for coffee drinkers who enjoy a strong cup, with the characteristic bittersweet notes. We recommend brewing this as an espresso, moka pot, french press, south indian filter.

name: Silver Oak Blend [250 gms]
description: This coffee has medium acidity and medium bitterness. Enjoy our signature house blend that we serve in our cafes! this versatile medium roast features a combination of washed and unwashed coffees to create a balanced profile that works well in espresso based drinks as well as in manual brews such as the aeropress, pour over or in cold brews.

name: French Roast [250 gms]
description: This coffee has low acidity and high bitterness. Our darkest roasted coffee is a blend best enjoyed black for those who like their coffee bold, like a traditional espresso. If you’re looking to add milk and still retain a definite bite, this is a great choice. We recommend brewing this as an espresso, moka pot, french press or south indian filter.

name: Basankhan Estate [250 gms]
description: This coffee has low acidity and medium-high bitterness. This dark roasted coffee is a journey of rich, complex flavours. Savour the velvety mouthfeel reminiscent of dark chocolate, which enhances the overall richness of this brew. The coffee’s body is heavy and round, creating a luscious and full-bodied experience for your palate.

name: Attikan Estate
description: This coffee has medium acidity and medium-high bitterness. Sweet with fruity overtones and balanced acidity, this is the darkest of our standard medium roasts and recommended for espresso lovers. It is a versatile coffee that also works for manual brewing such as moka pot, south indian filter and aeropress.

name: Cold Brew Blend Bold [250 gms]
description: This coffee has low acidity and medium-high bitterness. Our bold cold brew blend is roasted medium-dark that gives a full bodied glass of refreshing cold brew. With notes of dark chocolate, toffee, and roasted nuts, this blend has very little acidity and a bittersweet finish.

name: Amaltas Blend [250 gms]
description: An ode to the vibrant burst of yellow that marks the beginning of indian summers, this blend is our go-to choice for crafting a refreshing batch of coffee including cold brews. In fact, this was originally called the cold bold blend but owing to its diversity (its flavours shine through in a pour over or aeropress), we decided to rename it after one of our favourite neighbourhood trees.

name: Dhak Blend [250 gms]
description: This coffee has low acidity and medium-high bitterness. The coffees used in our dhak blend are naturally processed which means that the coffee bean is dried with the cherry, resulting in complex, fruity and sweet flavours. We recommend this dark roast for espresso-based drinks as well as manual brews such as the moka pot and the french press.

name: Winter Blend (250 Gms)
description: This coffee treats you to a balanced acidity and a pleasant sweetness. A medium-roasted blend crafted using natural and washed coffees, it brews cups with comforting notes, perfect for cosying up this winter.
